description: CUR-EDIT original-evidence controls (c) and (f), variant: what makes A's Update a conflict? A (default Workspace Database) edits N of a row while B (a second Database of the same Workspace) (c) updates N of another row ID 3 while A edits ID 2; (f2) changes S of the same row ID 4 to 'tmp' and back to 's4' while A edits N of ID 4; (f3) runs UPDATE T SET N = N on the same row ID 6 while A edits N of ID 6. After each A Update, Errors, EditMode and N are read; at the end every row is read through both Databases.
retentionNote: Designed r-q-cursor-dao probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
